locations.note: A killer is burning homeless people in New York, and student Henry White investigates.
Amnesiac John Yesterday goes to Paris to resume an interrupted search, with a hotel and an antiques shop among the stops.
The finale is at the ruins of St. Fergus Church in Inverloch Woods, with an underground chamber.

routes.name: Yesterday
routes.note: From the New York subway station to Paris and the Scottish ruins.
